values.note: Partial hook-up (water and electric) $41 a night, full hook-up $44, up to 6 guests; each extra guest $8 a night (10 people max per site); $3.50 booking fee. Tent sites (shared water and electric) $34. Monthly: full hook-up $706, partial $655.

fees.source: https://www.goldenbellccc.org/rv-tent-park (PRICING: 'Full hook-up sites (water, electric and sewer) $44 per night + $3.50 booking fee up to 6 guests'; 'Partial hook-up sites (water & electric) $41 per night + $3.50 booking fee'; 'Additional guests $8 per person per night'), read 2026-10-27. The rates are undated; the page's cancellation policy is 'effective March 2025' and its linked map and policy sheet are dated January 2026. The Firefly booking engine sits behind reCAPTCHA, so no quote.

hookups.source: https://www.goldenbellccc.org/_files/ugd/ccbdfd_9b22053942c54a46a558186a78b0f11d.pdf (site table: ELECTRIC AMPS 20 or 30 per site; key 'FULL HOOK-UP SITES (WATER, ELECTRIC & SEWER)', 'UNMARKED SITES (WATER & ELECTRIC)'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 32 RV sites plus 3 tent sites. Site lengths 20-40 ft (site 23 is 20 ft, site 5 is 22 ft). The map marks 12 RV sites monthly-only and 5 for volunteers, leaving about 16 for nightly guests.

sites.source: https://www.goldenbellccc.org/_files/ugd/ccbdfd_7d063439a65f429fb3f829ea59fdc4e9.pdf ('32 RV sites (full hookup and partial hookup)', '3 tent sites') + https://www.goldenbellccc.org/_files/ugd/ccbdfd_9b22053942c54a46a558186a78b0f11d.pdf (MAX RV LENGTH per site, 20'-40'; red dots 'MONTHLY SITES ONLY' on 1, 2, 5, 6, 8, 9, 13, 17, 26-29; blue 'VOLUNTEER SITES ONLY' on 11, 12, 14, 22, 25), read 2026-10-27

season.source: https://www.goldenbellccc.org/_files/ugd/ccbdfd_9b22053942c54a46a558186a78b0f11d.pdf (footer 'May - September / 719.687.9561 / www.goldenbellccc.org'), read 2026-10-27. The stored year_round: true rested on note prose only.

values.note: 'Reservations required!' Nightly sites book online (Firefly, 'Click here to book nightly sites') or by phone, 719-687-9561, Monday-Friday 8 am-5 pm; monthly sites by phone ('Call for availability'). Cancelling 8+ days out costs $25; within 7 days $25 plus one night. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.goldenbellccc.org/rv-tent-park ('Reservations required!', 'Click here to book nightly sites' -> Firefly, 'Call 719.687.9561 Monday-Friday 8am-5pm', cancellation policy) , read 2026-10-27

note: Church camp (Colorado District Church of the Nazarene) in the forested foothills at the base of Pikes Peak, ~9,180 ft, with an RV park sold to the public by the night. No alcohol or marijuana on camp property. Heated indoor pool (no lifeguard), mini golf, disc golf, catch-and-release fishing, camp hiking trails. --Claude
summary: Operator page + 2026 site map and policy sheet: confirmed $41-44 (now with $3.50 booking fee), water and sewer, reservable online (Firefly). Added 30-amp max, 32 RV sites to 40 ft, showers/dump, fcfs never. Season changed year-round -> not year-round (map captioned 'May - September'; no dates). Public nightly booking confirmed (Firefly, 'book nightly sites'). Pull-through left as stored (not stated). Note trimmed of field restatements, 'open year-round' and the unsourced no-smoking line.
flags: Long-stay mix (passes): of the 32 RV sites the 2026 map marks 12 monthly-only and 5 volunteer-only, so about 16 are sold nightly (half the park, well over 1 in 10); nightly rates are posted and booked online, so tests 2 and 4 pass. Only 2 nightly sites (15, 24) are full hook-up.
Season: stored year_round: true (note prose) contradicted by the RV park map's 'May - September' caption; set year_round false with no dates. Worth a call (719-687-9561) if exact dates matter.
Price gate: base $41 (partial hook-up), under US$50; no gateway within 40 km (nearest Denver 88 km) - not needed.
